verbatim: 目前，我国对于真实、合法的经常项目和已开放的资本项目下购汇和结汇都没有金额限制 … 年度便利化额度不是个人每年购汇或者结汇的限额，只是超过等值5万美元的购汇或结汇不能仅凭本人有效身份证件办理

title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (国务院令第532号) 2008-08-05
what_it_establishes: Art. 5: the State does not restrict current international payments and transfers. Art. 12: current-account FX business must rest on a genuine, lawful transaction and the bank must review the documents. Art. 39: evasion of FX control (逃汇) - fine up to 30% of the amount, 30% to 100% in serious cases. Art. 40: illegal purchase of FX with false documents - the money is returned and the same fine scale applies. Art. 42: illegal carriage of FX across the border - warning, fine up to 20%. Art. 45: private dealing in FX - warning, confiscation of gains, fine up to 30%, 30-100% in serious cases. Art. 42: 违反规定携带外汇出入境的，给予警告，可以处违法金额20%以下的罚款。
verbatim: 第五条 国家对经常性国际支付和转移不予限制 … 第三十九条 … 处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款 … 第四十二条 违反规定携带外汇出入境的，由外汇管理机关给予警告，可以处违法金额20%以下的罚款

title: 国家税务总局 国家外汇管理局公告2013年第40号 (tax filing for outbound payments)

title: 26 U.S.C. § 988 - Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions (2023 edition)
what_it_establishes: A disposition of nonfunctional currency is a section 988 transaction; gain or loss is ordinary (988(a)(1)(A)). For an individual's personal transaction, no gain is recognised on exchange-rate change unless the gain exceeds USD 200 (988(e)(2)); a personal transaction is one whose allocable expenses do not meet section 162 or 212 (988(e)(3)).
verbatim: The preceding provisions of this section shall not apply to any section 988 transaction entered into by an individual which is a personal transaction … The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200

title: Publication 525 (2025) Taxable and Nontaxable Income - Foreign currency transactions
how_read: passage located by official-site search and read
what_it_establishes: IRS states the individual-level rule for a personal foreign-currency gain: nothing to include up to USD 200; above USD 200 report it as a capital gain.
verbatim: If you have a gain on a personal foreign currency transaction because of changes in exchange rates, you don't have to include that gain in your income unless it's more than $200. If the gain is more than $200, report it as a capital gain.

title: Topic no. 409 - Capital gains and losses
what_it_establishes: Long-term capital gain rates for 2025: 0% up to USD 48,350 of taxable income (single), 15% up to USD 533,400, 20% above; short-term gain is taxed as ordinary income. A personal-use asset's loss is not deductible.
verbatim: A capital gains rate of 15% applies if your taxable income is … more than $48,350 but less than or equal to $533,400 for single … A capital gains rate of 20% applies to the extent that your taxable income exceeds the thresholds set for the 15% capital gain rate

title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
what_it_establishes: FBAR (FinCEN 114) threshold: aggregate foreign financial accounts exceed USD 10,000 at any time in the calendar year; due 15 April with automatic extension to 15 October; filed with FinCEN, not the IRS. Form 8938 thresholds for a specified individual living in the US: more than USD 50,000 at year end or USD 75,000 at any time (single).
verbatim: Aggregate value of financial accounts exceeds $10,000 at any time during the calendar year … Unmarried individual (or married filing separately): Total value of assets was more than $50,000 on the last day of the tax year, or more than $75,000 at any time during the year
